'''Jeff Thompson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Tempe tournament]] on 14 October 2000 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1344">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-14-az-tournament-that-didnt-take-15-hoursd1344/ az-tournament-that-didnt-take-15-hours], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 14 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-14-az-tournament-that-didnt-take-15-hoursd1344/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
